say: A thousand agents start in ramps, at most about three hundred and fifty busy at once, each on its own files. Each also writes one line in a shared index, so they collide thousands of times, and every collision is redone on the newest code. The files the checks rejected are left unchanged; the rest land on main.
The run's own page: the index check, five thousand seven hundred eighty-seven lines, none missing, and every one of the two thousand seven hundred ninety-one collisions redone.
